Taxonomical Analysis

First look

High-level taxonomy (Superkingdoms, kingdoms, and phylum)

Superkingdoms

  • There are 1 superkingdom(s), namely: Eukaryota. Eukaryotes represent 100 (There are 0 from Bacteria).

Kingdoms

  • There are 3 kingdoms, namely: Viridiplantae, Fungi, Metazoa. Here is the distribution:

Phylum

  • There are 42 phylums, namely: Streptophyta, Ascomycota, Arthropoda, Chordata, Euglenozoa, Basidiomycota, Ciliophora, Bacillariophyta, Microsporidia, Chlorophyta, Evosea, Apicomplexa, Parabasalia, Fornicata, Cnidaria, Nematoda, Oomycota, Mollusca, Heterolobosea, Rhodophyta, Echinodermata, Chytridiomycota, Perkinsozoa, Porifera, Platyhelminthes, Placozoa, Mucoromycota, Discosea, Haptophyta, Annelida, Foraminifera, Cryptomycota, Endomyxa, Blastocladiomycota, Zoopagomycota, Orthonectida, Brachiopoda, Tardigrada, Rotifera, Cercozoa, Bryozoa, Olpidiomycota.

Families of model organisms

Considered model organisms (and respective orders): if they are in our protein phylogeny

  • Mus musculus (Rodentia): TRUE

  • Rattus norvegicus (Rodentia): TRUE

  • Drosophila melanogaster (Drosophilidae): FALSE

  • Bos taurus (Artiodactyla): TRUE

  • Callosobruchus maculatus (Coleoptera): TRUE

  • Danio rerio (Cypriniformes): TRUE

  • Fundulus heteroclitus (Cyprinodontiformes) ~not a “model” : TRUE

  • Nothobranchius furzeri (Cyprinodontiformes): TRUE

  • Oryzias latipes (Beloniformes): TRUE

  • Anolis carolinensis (Squamata): TRUE

  • Gallus gallus (Galliformes): TRUE (UPI001F01E243 is in Gallus gallus?)

  • Taeniopygia castanotis (Passeriformes): TRUE

  • Xenopus laevis (Anura): TRUE

  • Xenopus tropicalis (Anura): TRUE

  • Saccharomyces cerevisiae (Saccharomycetales): TRUE

  • Any primate might be good to start with (Primates): TRUE

  • Caenorhabditis elegans (Rhabditida): TRUE

  • Strongylocentrotus purpuratus (Echinoida): FALSE

There are low amount of hits in Muridae, but it can be interesting since it has Rattus and Mus in it as geni (mice and rats as model organisms)
